hero.headline: DailyVal Creator Program
hero.subheadline: Put your Valorant content in front of 1.2M+ players. Official certification, in-app featuring, monthly pay, and view bonuses. Applications always open, no follower minimum.

tiers.title: Three Tiers
tiers.subtitle: Start with free certification. Consistent quality gets you invited into the paid tiers with a fixed monthly stipend.

items.name: Certified Creator
items.subtitle: 認證創作者
requirements: 3+ published Valorant-related works on a public account
Post at least 1 DailyVal-related work every 90 days to stay certified
rewards: Featured placement on the app's home screen

items.name: Creator
items.subtitle: 創作者
requirements: Invited from the certified pool; 3-month written contract
1 video or 4 social posts featuring DailyVal per month

items.name: Partner
items.subtitle: 合作夥伴
requirements: 2 short videos per month + official event promotion
rewards: Direct collaboration with the DailyVal team

tiers.promotionNote: Every paid collaboration is backed by a written contract.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Submit your channel and 1–3 representative works.

steps.title: Weekly Review
steps.description: We review in weekly batches and reply within 5–7 business days.

steps.title: Get Certified
steps.description: Receive your badge, Premium, and Discord invite, then start creating.

steps.title: Level Up
steps.description: Consistent quality output puts you first in line for paid slots.

bonus.title: View Bonuses
bonus.subtitle: All tiers eligible. Counted within 30 days of each piece going live.
bonus.note: No cap: every piece counts independently. Paid via bank transfer (Taiwan) or PayPal (international).

examples.title: Content Examples
examples.subtitle: Not sure what program content looks like? See how creators weave DailyVal into their videos. These are from our collaboration with OrangeMao (橘毛).

items.q: How many followers do I need?
items.a: There's no follower minimum. We care about quality, passion, and potential. New creators are welcome.

items.q: Can I apply from outside Taiwan?
items.a: Yes, the program is fully global, any language. International rewards are paid via PayPal.
We review in weekly batches and reply by email within 5–7 business days.
Post at least 1 DailyVal-related work every 90 days to stay active. If it lapses, your next work reactivates it automatically, no re-application needed.

items.q: How do I get into a paid tier?
items.a: When paid slots open, we invite the top-performing certified creators first, always with a written contract.
Applications never close. Build up more Valorant content and apply again anytime.
